title: Easy Harness
description: Simplifies harness recipes by making them shapeless and allowing any type of glass.
body:
This datapack simplifies the crafting of a `harness`. Crafts are demonstrated in the gallery.

All changes:
- `Harness` crafting is `Shapeless`
- Can use any type of `glass` (except `tinted`)
    - **Note**: Using `stained glass` does NOT affect the harness texture in ANY way
- In the harness craft, you can also use a `dye` to immediately create a harness of the selected dye's color
- Also adds a craft for a `white harness` from `strings`, because 4 `strings` = 1 `white wool`
